calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor, shear modulus, and bulk modulus for a set of atomic structures
run_elasticity_with_job_sharding: run elasticity calculations on a subset of structures using job_num and num_jobs for parallel execution
write_elasticity_results_to_json: write elasticity calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified results directory
convert_elastic_units_to_gpa: convert elastic tensor and modulus values from eV/Angstrom^3 to GPa using the eVA3_to_GPa constant
handle_elasticity_calculation_errors: handle exceptions during elasticity calculations by capturing errors and tracebacks in the results dictionary
